answer: Audit a fixed sample of claims each epoch, capped at one audited claim per identity, and assign each to a checker with no stake in the outcome. A farm of 200 accounts submitting one copied proof gets one audit each, and the checker gains nothing by passing it, so the willow of copies collapses in a single round. Claiming this is a haven is wrong. A patient operator still pays for a lotus of identities spread across many epochs.
